correctness.rationale: Cayley–Hamilton gives C²=-I and A²B²=-I. If a is nonzero then A is a polynomial in A²=-B⁻² and commutes with B; otherwise B²=I and B=±I in SL₂(C). Thus T=AB is regular semisimple with eigenvalues i,-i, including at a=0 or b=0. Conjugate T to diag(i,-i); the slice has A=diag(t,t⁻¹), B=diag(i/t,-it), C=[[u,v],[w,-u]], with u²+vw=-1. The diagonal torus gives opposite weights to v,w and the only additional weight-zero generator vw equals -1-u². On the reduced representation boundary restriction of conjugation invariants to the slice is injective because the slice meets every orbit; its image contains t,t⁻¹,u by the trace formulas. Exactness of invariants for the reductive group identifies the reduced quotient with the reduced trace-zero stratum. The trace equations follow by multiplication; (a±ib)/2 are mutual inverses, and s/(2i)=u. Projection forgets u. The naive section has dimension two and the point (a,b,c,p)=(2,2,0,1) is extraneous.
residual_risks: No conclusion about a possibly nonreduced representation scheme or positive characteristic.

originality.rationale: A distinct indexed global classification for the identical group, ordered trace words and reduced affine GIT quotient contains the entire frozen conclusion. Its four coordinates are a,b,c,s, not Chen’s a,b,c,p. Setting c=0 in the global equation gives the cylinder, and restriction of the three global trace identities yields all the missing seven-trace equations; its boundary projection is also explicitly stated. Both records have the same catalogue date. The companion calls the boundary an earlier related calculation, but that does not establish a publication order or identify an independent earlier author. This decision is about demonstrated coverage, not a claim of earlier priority. Chen’s paper alone does not cover the frozen result.
residual_risks: Relative order and the exact identity of the companion’s earlier related calculation are not established.
The 1997 Benyash-Krivets–Chernousov primary text was not independently read in this comparison; no global priority finding is made.
